label: Local/communal conflict events (UCDP)
aggregation: count of GED non-state/one-sided events by local actors
source: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset (GED) v26.1; actor classification scripts/intracounty_conflict.py
notes: Local violence: UCDP non-state + one-sided events whose perpetrators are communal identity groups (Dinka/Nuer sections, Murle, Toposa, Misseriya, ...) or South Sudanese local militias (NAS, SPLA-IO factions, UCDP actors AAKG and CPC) fighting each other or attacking civilians. Government and foreign actors excluded. Only deadly events of dyads above UCDP's 25-deaths/year threshold, so cattle raiding is under-counted; counted where the event happened (actors' home county unknown). Zeros in 2018 make ratio indexing meaningless (index_ok false).
